en.report.title: Report a problem
en.report.pill_tip: Report a problem: file a private ticket with what you choose to attach
en.report.private_note: Files a private ticket on tickets.solidcraft.io. Only you, triagers and admins can see it.
en.report.summary_hint: A short title for the problem
en.report.description_hint: What happened, and what did you expect?
en.report.system_note: App version, operating system, graphics card and driver.
en.report.repro_note: The last {count} commands with their settings and results, and the failing command with its error. Settings can include sizes and names from your design.
en.report.log_note: The last {count} lines of SolidCraft's messages. Your home folder is shown as ~.
en.report.design_note: Uploads your open design so we can reproduce the problem. Only you, triagers and admins can see it. It is never made public.
en.report.crash_note: The internal error's message, where it happened and the commands before it.
en.report.sign_in_needed: Sign in to tickets.solidcraft.io to send reports. Your browser opened the sign-in page: enter this code there.
en.report.sign_in_waiting: Waiting for you to approve the sign-in…
en.report.queued: You are offline: the report is queued and will send when you are online.
en.report.cancelled_filed: Sending stopped. Ticket #{number} was filed without all its attachments.
en.report.token_unsaved: Signed in for this session only: the system keyring could not keep the sign-in.
en.prefs.reports.github: Report a bug opens a GitHub draft instead
en.prefs.reports.github_help: Off: Report a bug opens the in-app report, which files a private ticket. On: it opens a public GitHub issue draft, as before.
en.prefs.reports.signed_out: Not signed in to tickets.solidcraft.io. Sending a report signs you in.

de.report.title: Problem melden

ar.prefs.reports.github: زر الإبلاغ عن خطأ يفتح مسودة على GitHub بدلًا من ذلك
ar.prefs.reports.github_help: إيقاف: يفتح زر الإبلاغ عن خطأ التقرير داخل التطبيق الذي ينشئ تذكرة خاصة. تشغيل: يفتح مسودة مشكلة عامة على GitHub كما كان سابقًا.

he.report.title: דיווח על בעיה

he.report.private_note: יוצר כרטיס פרטי ב-tickets.solidcraft.io. רק אתם, הממיינים והמנהלים יכולים לראות אותו.

he.prefs.reports.github: דיווח על באג פותח טיוטה ב-GitHub במקום זאת
he.prefs.reports.github_help: כבוי: דיווח על באג פותח את הדוח שבתוך היישום, שיוצר כרטיס פרטי. מופעל: הוא פותח טיוטת בעיה ציבורית ב-GitHub, כמו קודם.
he.prefs.reports.signed_out: לא מחוברים ל-tickets.solidcraft.io. שליחת דוח תחבר אתכם.
